summary: Entropy NaN bug fixed (10k episodes, seed=0, buffer=100k, 32 envs). Grasp reached 100% at step 6015 — slightly slower than prior run despite the fix (entropy starting at 0.09 then recovering to 1.52). All grow_* goals stayed at 0%. LP estimates still ended at 0.0 despite brief nonzero readings — the LP signal issue is separate from the entropy NaN bug.

findings.description: Entropy is finite throughout (no NaN — bug fixed vs 5d2058d7). Rose from 0.079 to 1.52. Value loss ended at 0.009 — slightly high, may not have fully converged within 10k episodes.
Reached 100% at step 6015 — slightly slower than 5d2058d7 (step 5005) despite fixing the entropy bug. Grasp volatility: n_collapses=0, fraction_above_last_quarter=1.0 — stably learned.

All LP estimates ended at 0.0 despite 4-5 nonzero readings mid-run. LP signal is not persisting even after entropy fix. Possible causes: LP threshold too aggressive, SR head not learning per-goal features, or insufficient replay diversity at 10k episodes.
findings.recommendation: Check if LP stays nonzero with 64 envs (more diverse replay) and longer runs. Confirmed working in 706d17e9 with 64 envs.

findings.description: 0% at end. Expected at 10k episodes with 32 envs.

comparison: vs. 5d2058d7: entropy NaN fixed — entropy rises cleanly from 0.079 to 1.52. Grasp still learned. LP signal still 0 at end — confirms LP issue is independent of entropy NaN. Same config (32 envs, buffer=100k).
